subject: 해커스 수능영어독해 미니모의고사
title: 12회 5번 · 빈칸 추론하기
fullPassage: In the realm of philosophy, it is widely believed that the identity of opposing ideas is inconsequential, as they are constantly changing; in the grand scheme, when one idea changes, another idea arises in opposition to it, continuing the dialogue that drives philosophical progress. However, when looking at social dynamics, this tenet does not hold true, as opposition becomes a stepping stone to conflict. In a political context, especially in situations that bring about questions of social justice, we often grow to view those who hold values in opposition to our own with antagonism and dismiss them as being irrational or immoral. It is not that their perspectives are entirely without merit or reason. It is that we are so fundamentally opposed to their way of thinking that we believe no rational or moral person could hold such beliefs and thus refuse to interact with them, regardless of the quality of their argument. This breakdown in communication can ultimately lead to polarization, or the splitting of a society, making it more difficult to find solutions to social and political issues.
